Great! Before you start coding, remember that the key to this problem lies in understanding how "path score" is defined. Unlike traditional shortest path problems, here you care about the minimum edge weight along any path from city 1 to city n. The optimal score is the highest such minimum you can guarantee on some path connecting those cities.

Consider how this definition relates to concepts like connectivity and graph traversal. Focusing on the underlying graph structure and what it means for a road to be the smallest on some path will help you design an efficient and correct approach.
